  PROBLEM: The new contractual refusal reason base_ref_invalid (emitted at scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh line 391) is missing from REFUSAL_REASONS. Its only cases (base_ref_leading_dash_refuses, base_ref_dotdot_refuses, base_ref_head_refuses) are written to tmp_path in test_reissue_edge_cases (line 358, comment at line 363) rather than FIXTURE_DIR, so neither the coverage guard at line 89 (`REFUSAL_REASONS <= reasons`) nor `bash scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh --self-test` ever exercises it.
  WHY: Renaming, dropping or merging the token (for example into pr_lookup_failed or branch_lookup_failed) would leave both the shell self-test and the coverage contract green, even though the agents.d fragment declares the token part of the stable CI_TRIAGE_PR_BRANCH_ROUTING contract. All three reviewers rated it NIT (low); confidence ranged from 3 to 4. Suggested fix: add "base_ref_invalid" to REFUSAL_REASONS and commit reissue_merged_pr_base_ref_invalid_refuses.json with base.ref "-bad", expected_exit_code 3 and expected_error_reason "base_ref_invalid".
